gappers.catalyst: Positive Ph2 FREEDOM2-DM1 10 mg/kg topline (PGN-EDODM1, myotonic dystrophy 1) plus Q3 results.
headlines: Why is PepGen stock surging today? (Investing.com, 2026-11-10)
gappers.catalyst_detail: 10 mg/kg cohort: mean muscle splicing correction 46.5% at Wk13 vs 6.8% placebo; 5/6 pts >20%, 4/6 >50%. Grip strength +16.2% at Wk16; 10m walk/run improved. Well tolerated. Cash $104.8M, runway into 2028; 12.5 mg/kg cohort fully enrolled, data 1H27.
gappers.why: Strong pharmacodynamic plus functional data de-risks a rare-disease Ph2 asset and a micro-cap re-rates; funded runway lowers dilution fear near-term.
gappers.impact: Volume 448k pre-open is meaningful for a $2 stock, but +156% is a binary-event gap with 52w high $7.80 overhead; follow-on equity raise is a common fade trigger. Small-n (6 pts) data.
gappers.horizon: SHORT_TERM, binary biotech spike; offering risk and thin n, no sector-rotation fit; do not carry.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Sub-$10 biotech with an extreme gap rarely supports a sane stop at 2:1 R:R (10% trail is ~$0.60 of chop). Would use one of 3 weekly trade slots on a lottery-style setup; BW or higher-quality names are better uses.
